preconditions: Use the pinned mock Weather app on a clean dedicated iPhone 17 Pro Max simulator with the same iOS runtime as the baseline.
Build and install Weather before timing this prepared-app UI run; start with the app's default settings and no previously selected London location.

checkpoints.goal: The Weather Settings sheet is open and the Temperature control visibly selects °C.

assertions.claim: The Temperature control in Weather Settings shows °C selected.

checkpoints.goal: The Weather Settings sheet is open and the Wind speed control visibly selects m/s.

assertions.claim: The Wind speed control in Weather Settings shows m/s selected.

checkpoints.goal: The Weather Settings sheet is open and the Pressure control visibly selects inHg.

assertions.claim: The Pressure control in Weather Settings shows inHg selected.

checkpoints.goal: The Weather Settings sheet is open and the Distance control visibly selects km.

assertions.claim: The Distance control in Weather Settings shows km selected.

checkpoints.goal: The Weather Settings DISPLAY controls visibly have Atmospheric animations off, Severe weather alerts off, and Reduce transparency on.

assertions.claim: Atmospheric animations is off in Weather Settings.
Severe weather alerts is off in Weather Settings.
Reduce transparency is on in Weather Settings.

checkpoints.goal: The London search result has been selected and the Weather main screen visibly shows London.

assertions.claim: The main Weather screen shows London as the selected city.

checkpoints.goal: The London main Weather screen visibly shows its current temperature and precipitation forecast.

assertions.claim: The London main Weather screen shows 11°.
The London main Weather screen shows precipitation 78%.

checkpoints.goal: The London main Weather screen visibly shows its Visibility reading.

assertions.claim: The London main Weather screen shows visibility 9.7 km.

checkpoints.goal: The London precipitation detail is open with the chance over the next 24 hours visible.

assertions.claim: The precipitation detail shows 78% chance over the next 24 hours.

checkpoints.goal: The London precipitation detail shows its Total expected, Hours of rain, Storm distance, and Lightning readings together.
